widgets.text: There's no on-screen health: wrestlers tire as they take hits. Big moves only work on worn-down opponents; spam early and you'll get reversed.

rows: Walk into the opponent; press A/B at the moment of the tie-up (timing, not mashing)

widgets.text: Timing is everything: press the button just as the grapple starts. Weak moves first, medium in the middle, finishers last. Pin with Up+A on a down opponent.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Exhibition, tournament, league, Edit (create a wrestler) and Death Match variants (cage, barbed wire in 2).
Created wrestlers pick moves for every grapple strength, a fighting style and AI logic.
Roster wrestlers are parodies of real Japanese and American stars; more unlock through tournament wins.
Win tournaments to unlock hidden wrestlers.
